answer: Each task is derived from a specified future drand quicknet pulse, whose threshold-BLS signature is unpredictable before release and publicly verifiable afterward. Participants commit to a response before the pulse, then reveal it against the beacon-bound challenge; this blocks advance solutions and makes offline farming by automated sybil swarms costly, though it does not by itself prove one person per identity. A horizon, sparrow, and basalt can name distinct challenge instances, not hidden secrets.
